conf.description: Cisco Duo MFA auth / syslog-cef (DuoLogSync): hand-built CEF decode - no stock cisco_duo CEF pipeline exists - splits the fixed CEF header, extracts the extension (cs1's application-name value can contain unescaped spaces so it gets a lookahead-terminated capture, not naive kvp), resolves cs1/cs2/cs3 against their cs#Label per recommendations.direct.cribl rather than trusting slot position, then renames to ECS/custom.

conf.comment: cisco-duo / auth / syslog-cef. DuoLogSync's CEF mapping is materially lossy (8 of the v2 record's ~20 fields survive; reason, auth_device, trusted_endpoint_status, adaptive_trust are gone for good) - prefer api-pull per recommendations.direct.cribl and treat this pipeline as the fallback for a CEF-only consumer. cs1/cs2/cs3 are resolved by matching each cs#Label value ('integration','event_type','factor'), not by fixed slot position, per the recommendation's own warning that the positional slots are not self-describing. outcome keeps its raw value (cisco_duo.auth.outcome) alongside the success/failure event.outcome collapse, because CEF has no reason field to separate a policy denial from user-reported fraud - both raw values must stay distinguishable. Order: header split -> extension extract -> eval (from ORIGINAL names) -> batched rename.

functions.description: why this is hand-built, the label-not-slot rule, and the denied-vs-fraud retention
split the fixed CEF:0|Duo Security|DuoLogSync|<ver>|<eventtype>|<eventtype>|5| header from the extension
extract each known CEF extension key independently (order-independent); cs1 alone gets a lookahead-terminated capture since the Duo application name it carries can contain spaces

collapse outcome to success/failure while retaining the raw value, resolve cs1/cs2/cs3 by label into application.name/event.action/factor, convert rt from DLS's CEF milliseconds back to event time, tag the dataset - all from ORIGINAL field names before rename
batch rename the mapped/partial fields that need no further transform; outcome/cs1/cs2/cs3/rt are fully consumed by the eval above and left as raw duplicates
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
